resolution: Fixed the iso keydown crash by restoring a local normalizeYawDegrees helper in IsoAuthor.tsx. The selected-rotation path uses it when R rotates loose pieces/buildings; without the helper, every keydown listener threw before rotate handling could complete. Verified hmsc-int bundles cleanly.
